title: The Pale Lady
description: Outside Frostmere Crypt, bandits attack one of their own over a stolen sword. The thief, Ra'jirr, fled into the tunnels below to stop a spectral figure haunting his dreams. Pursue him, confront the Pale Lady, and choose whether to banish her by returning the sword or slay her and claim The Pale Blade.

base_facts: I am a bandit who was attacked by my own gang outside Frostmere Crypt.
My friend Ra'jirr stole a sword from our leader Kyr.
I carry a journal that explains what happened.

ARRIVE_AT_CRYPT: The stranger witnessed the bandits attacking me and learned about the theft inside Frostmere Crypt.
LEARN_THEFT_MOTIVE: The stranger has read my journal and knows Ra'jirr stole the sword to stop the Pale Lady.

base_facts: I am the leader of the bandit gang at Frostmere Crypt.
One of my own, Ra'jirr, stole a sword from me and fled into the tunnels.

LEARN_THEFT_MOTIVE: The stranger knows I pursued Ra'jirr into the tunnels below the crypt.
KYR_SLAIN: I was ambushed and killed by Ra'jirr in the underground forest.

base_facts: I stole The Pale Blade from Kyr to stop the Pale Lady haunting my dreams.
I fled into the tunnels beneath Frostmere Crypt to seal her away.

LEARN_THEFT_MOTIVE: The stranger knows I stole the sword to stop the Pale Lady.
PALE_LADY_APPEARS: The Pale Lady appeared before I could seal her. I may be dead or dying.
BANISH_PALE_LADY: The stranger returned The Pale Blade to the altar and banished the Pale Lady.
Player returns The Pale Blade to the altar, banishing the Pale Lady and completing the quest peacefully.

After you have slain The Pale Lady, make sure that you follow the path west-southwest of the pedestal until you get to the end of a rock formation, turn right and climb up to find another path that leads to a.
The next room has a bridge leading over a pool of water back to the entrance of the ruins.
SLAY_PALE_LADY: The stranger killed the Pale Lady and claimed The Pale Blade.

beats.comment: Player encounters bandits attacking Eisa outside Frostmere Crypt and learns about the theft.
Player learns Ra'jirr stole the sword to stop the Pale Lady and follows Kyr and Ra'jirr into the tunnels.
Ra'jirr ambushes and kills Kyr before heading into the underground forest.
The Pale Lady appears and attacks before Ra'jirr can seal her away.
Player returns The Pale Blade to the altar, banishing the Pale Lady and completing the quest peacefully.
Player kills the Pale Lady and claims The Pale Blade as a reward.
